summary: The corrected schedule passed, but exact G1 loading stopped because the copied XML lacked its relative STL asset directory.
evidence: MuJoCo reported the missing inputs/assets/pelvis.STL before any frame rendered.
The complete frozen G1 and Sharpa asset trees were subsequently located under ignored external checkouts with XML hashes identical to the registry.
lessons: An exact XML digest does not make an asset executable when its hash-compatible relative mesh tree is absent.
limitations: No frame or physical gate completed in this attempt.
next_actions: Use the complete external asset paths without editing the hash-bound XML and rerun in a new directory.
